## What and why

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Checklist

- [ ] `python tools/check_skill.py` passes.
- [ ] Every new fact about a third-party tool was read on the provider's official page, and its URL is in `tools/verified_sources.json` with the date.
- [ ] New guidance says which risk it reduces, what it costs, and when it is not needed.
- [ ] A line describing the change is in the newest entry of `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] If the change affects recommendations, the relevant evaluation scenarios were run (say which, with the model and date).
